items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 27 at 10:55AM EDT until September 28 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, 1 to 2 feet of
inundation above ground level low-lying areas near shorelines
and tidal waterways with compromised dune structures. Elevated
water levels due to high astronomical tides and moderate west
winds may lead to localized minor flooding of low-lying areas
prone to soundside flooding. For the Beach Hazards Statement,
dangerous rip currents, large breaking waves, and hazardous
debris expected in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Northern Outer Banks ocean-side locales that
experienced weakening of dune structures over the last few
days. For soundside localized flooding, low-lying areas prone
to sound- side flooding in and near Manteo.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until midnight EDT
tonight. For the Beach Hazards Statement, through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Up to 1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level
is possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways with compromised dune structures resulting in a low
threat of property damage. Dangerous swimming and surfing
conditions and localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The next oceanside high tide times are
around 8:30 PM Sunday. The soundside high times are around
11:30 AM Sunday and midnight Sunday night. The most likely time
for strong rip currents to occur is a couple hours either side
of low tide, which will occur around 2:30 PM Sunday.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Watch out for debris that may be in the water.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 27 at 2:24AM EDT until September 27 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Oregon Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Seas will remain elevated through this
evening in the wake of this past week's Nor'easter.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
